root_cause.text: The driver requested the IRQ (using devm_request_threaded_irq) before registering the power supply (using devm_power_supply_register), causing devm cleanup to free the power supply before unregistering the IRQ handler, leading to a use-after-free when the IRQ handler calls power_supply_changed().
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "Using the `devm_` variant for requesting IRQ _before_ the `devm_` variant for allocating/registering the `power_supply` handle, means that the `power_supply` handle will be deallocated/unregistered _before_ the interrupt handler." The patch moves `bq25980_power_supply_init()` before the IRQ request.
